Install on a NAS

  1. Check the NAS against the host requirements: processor type, memory, free ports, and disk space.
  2. Create a folder for MTL Explorer on a NAS share that is kept permanently, not a temporary or cache folder. Keep docker-compose.yml, .env, and data/ together in that folder.
  3. Install with Docker Compose, using the NAS container manager or a terminal.
  4. Open http://<nas-address>:18080/mtl/ from a browser on the same network.
  5. Change the login. Set up HTTPS if you want to reach it from outside.
  6. Test one import, one planned route, and a backup and restore.

Make sure MTL Explorer can read your GPS folder and write to data/. If imports fail with "permission denied", check the folder permissions in your NAS settings.

  • Updating

Updating

Some NAS container managers keep their own copy of the Compose file. When you update, replace that copy with the new Compose file too; new images alone are not enough. Then recreate the containers in the container manager; a plain restart does not apply changed settings.
